body:
Confirming the `--container` item that was marked unconfirmed above, from the code at `main` (505941e): [`matchesFilter`](https://github.com/link-foundation/disk-space-saviour/blob/505941e8d1dd041c428f76a3f7b47c31a2f9eef5/src/docker/scan.js#L313-L321) accepts an **ID prefix** or an **exact name** only:

```js
return filters.some((filter) => ps.ID.startsWith(filter) || names.includes(filter));
```

So `--container 175ff931` (a name prefix, the way hive-mind task containers are usually referred to by their session UUID prefix) matches nothing, and dss then silently scans only the host, with no warning that the filter matched zero containers.

Suggested fix: also accept a unique name prefix, and fail (or at least warn) when a `--container` filter matches no container.
